hits.title: Empower Community Care Invests in Carey Group
hits.snippet: We intend to enhance its reach and breadth of services through additional investment that will help to expand Carey Group’s customer base, services, and products,” said Logan Greenspan and Josh Glade, co-CEOs of Empower. ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Empower Community Care (“Empower”), a leading global behavioral health organization responsible for distributing evidence-based programs and technologies, is pleased to announce it has acquired The Carey Group, Inc. (“TCG”) & Carey Group Publishing, LLC (“CGP”) (collectively, “Carey Group”). Carey Group will operate independently under the Empower platform. We intend to enhance its reach and breadth of services through additional investment that will help to expand Carey Group’s customer base, services, and products,” said Logan Greenspan and Josh Glade, co-CEOs of Empower. Carey Group provides consulting services and educational content to criminal and juvenile justice and other human and social services agencies. Empower’s existing investors include its management team and Northlane Capital Partners (“NCP”). Empower is the leading global behavioral health organization responsible for distributing evidence-based programs and technologies.
